title: Enterprise VPC quarterly planning runway and initiative heatmap
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: Produce a defensible quarterly roadmap for Enterprise Private (VPC + on-prem) features that maps to OKRs, shows initiative heat (risk/cost/complexity), and provides a two-week rollout runway for each tranche. Background: Several enterprise customers have signaled migration readiness but need clear timelines and upgrade guarantees. We need a single artifact the GTM, Sales Engineering, Delivery, and Eng leadership can act on. Scope: 1) Prioritize features and slices for FY26Q1 across VPC networking primitives, on-prem packaging, KMS/HSM integrations, and dedicated autoscaling policies. 2) Produce an initiative heatmap (x-axis: customer priority, y-axis: implementation risk) and a runway with release windows, canary thresholds, and rollback criteria. 3) Translate roadmap items into OKR-aligned milestones with measurable success metrics. Out-of-scope: Detailed sprint-level tasks (handled by engineering tickets), legal/compliance contract negotiation artifacts. Constraints: Limited dedicated infra capacity in EMEA for canaries, scheduled on-prem installer refactor in mid-March, and a pending kernel-switch PR that may change rollout order. Stakeholders: Product, Delivery, Sales Engineering, Legal, Security, Eng - runtime and infra teams.
acceptance_criteria: One consolidated quarterly roadmap slide and Confluence page that lists initiatives, owners, release windows, and dependencies
Heatmap artifact showing priority vs risk for each initiative, annotated with supporting rationale
OKR mappings for each initiative including target metrics and a single owner
Runway plan with canary thresholds (latency/error/cost), rollback gates, and an ops playbook link
Stakeholder sign-off captured from Sales Engineering, Delivery, and Security
success_metrics: % of prioritized customers with a confirmed migration window >= 60%
Mean time to rollback during canary < 30 minutes in staging
No P0 incidents during first 30 days of any tranche rollout
Alignment score: >=90% of stakeholders sign the roadmap by due date
milestones: Week 2: Internal review with Eng leadership and Delivery
Week 3: Customer-priority validation with top 6 customers
Week 5: Final roadmap + Confluence publish and all-hands review
Week 6-8: Prepare canary configurations and ops playbooks
updates: 2025-11-12 - Kickoff: aligned on goals with Eng and Delivery. Diego flagged the kernel-switch PR (ENG-10017) as a potential blocker for our PKCS#11 rollout timeline.

2025-11-25 - Sales Engineering session with top 6 customers to validate priority; three customers moved up KMS gating to critical.
2025-12-03 - Trade-off discussion: we can defer non-blocking UI console dashboard features to reduce scope and preserve Q1 on-prem delivery. PMs agreed to scope trim.
2025-12-10 - Legal requested a standard upgrade SLA template; Ben to draft. Marked dependency on Legal review for final customer-facing timeline.
2026-01-08 - Security review initiated for KMS/HSM integration; Evelyn requested HSM attestation details. Security review flagged for gating release to customers with higher compliance needs.
2026-02-02 - Capacity triage board created: EMEA canary capacity limited to 2 pods for dedicated testing weeks; added fallback region strategy to runway.
2026-02-15 - Eng completed a performance perf-run for autoscaling policies (ENG-9812) with positive results; updated risk from high->medium for autoscale feature.
2026-02-28 - Ops playbook draft uploaded; includes rollback commands, metrics to observe, and post-mortem template. Assigned on-call rotations for initial rollouts.

2026-03-10 - Final review scheduled for 2026-03-12. Pending items: Legal SLA, Security attestation, and kernel-switch PR resolution. Preparing slide deck for executive sync.
